Files.title: Files
Files.description: One row per data file submitted to the Common Fund Data Ecosystem by a DCC (ENCODE or 4DN), with its format, assay and size, and the collection, biosample and subject it came from.

fields.name: file_id
fields.title: File ID
fields.description: C2M2 local identifier of the file.

fields.name: accession
fields.description: DCC accession of the file, e.g. ENCFF… or 4DNFI….

fields.name: dcc
fields.title: DCC
fields.description: Data Coordinating Center that submitted the file: ENCODE or 4DN.

fields.name: file_format
fields.description: EDAM file format, e.g. FASTQ, BAM, bigWig, BED.

fields.name: data_type
fields.description: EDAM data type the file holds, e.g. Sequence alignment, Annotation track.

fields.name: assay
fields.description: OBI assay that produced the file, e.g. ChIP-seq assay, RNA-seq assay, Hi-C.

fields.name: output_type
fields.description: DCC-specific output type, e.g. reads, alignments, peaks, signal p-value.

fields.name: genome_assembly
fields.description: Reference genome the file is aligned to, e.g. GRCh38, hg19, mm10.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Release status at the DCC: released or archived (blank for 4DN).

fields.name: size_gb
fields.title: Size (GB)
fields.description: File size in gigabytes (10^9 bytes).

fields.name: created_year
fields.title: Year created
fields.description: Year the file was created at the DCC.

fields.name: species
fields.description: Species the file's data comes from (ENCODE's per-file organism, else the subject's), e.g. Homo sapiens, Mus musculus.

fields.name: anatomy
fields.description: UBERON anatomy or cell line of the file's collection (copied from Collections), e.g. K562, heart.

fields.name: collection_id
fields.title: Collection ID
fields.description: The collection (experiment or replicate set) the file belongs to.

fields.name: biosample_id
fields.title: Biosample ID
fields.description: The biosample the file's collection was assayed on.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.title: Subject ID
fields.description: The subject (organism or cell line) the biosample came from.

Collections.title: Collections
Collections.description: One row per C2M2 collection: an ENCODE experiment or annotation, or a 4DN experiment or replicate set. Groups the files produced together.

fields.name: collection_id
fields.title: Collection ID
fields.description: C2M2 local identifier of the collection.

fields.name: accession
fields.description: DCC accession, e.g. ENCSR… or 4DNEX….

fields.name: dcc
fields.title: DCC
fields.description: Data Coordinating Center: ENCODE or 4DN.

fields.name: lab
fields.description: Lab that produced the collection.

fields.name: experiment_type
fields.description: Experiment type, e.g. TF ChIP-seq, DNase-seq, in situ Hi-C.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Assay target for ChIP-seq and similar, e.g. CTCF-human, H3K27ac-human.

fields.name: analyte_class
fields.description: Class of molecule assayed, e.g. DNA, RNA, polyadenylated mRNA.

fields.name: anatomy
fields.description: UBERON anatomy or cell line the collection was assayed on.

fields.name: biosample_id
fields.title: Biosample ID
fields.description: The biosample the collection was assayed on.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.title: Subject ID
fields.description: The subject the biosample came from.

Biosamples.title: Biosamples
Biosamples.description: One row per biosample: tissue, cells or a cell line taken from a subject and assayed.

fields.name: biosample_id
fields.title: Biosample ID
fields.description: C2M2 local identifier of the biosample.

fields.name: dcc
fields.title: DCC
fields.description: Data Coordinating Center: ENCODE or 4DN.

fields.name: anatomy
fields.description: UBERON anatomy or cell type of the biosample, e.g. colon, stem cell.

fields.name: biosample_type
fields.description: ENCODE biosample type: cell line, tissue, primary cell, … (blank for 4DN).

fields.name: subject_count
fields.title: Subjects
fields.description: Number of subjects the biosample was pooled from.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.title: Subject ID
fields.description: The subject the biosample came from (the first, when pooled).

Subjects.title: Subjects
Subjects.description: One row per subject: an organism or cell line that biosamples were taken from.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.title: Subject ID
fields.description: C2M2 local identifier of the subject.

fields.name: dcc
fields.title: DCC
fields.description: Data Coordinating Center: ENCODE or 4DN.

fields.name: species
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy species, e.g. Homo sapiens, Mus musculus.

examplePrompts: How many files does each DCC have, broken down by file format?
What is the total file size in GB for each assay?
Which experiment types have the most collections?
How many files were created each year, by DCC?
Which anatomical sites have the most biosamples?
How many files are there per species and genome assembly?
